item.title: A better view shouldn’t mean taking your eyes off the patient.
item.dc:creator: XREAL_Global
item.content:encoded: A better view shouldn’t mean taking your eyes off the patient. In robotic surgery, physician assistant Emily Cain often has to choose between viewing a partially obstructed monitor or turning away from the operating table to see another screen. With XREAL AURA and apoQlar’s HoloMedicine Robotics, she can pin the surgeon’s 3D console view wherever she needs it, seeing the same real-time view as the surgeon while keeping the patient fully in sight. For surgeon Dr. Miguel Burch, AURA’s lightweight, see-through design also offers a more ergonomic way to work alongside robotic systems, addressing some of the challenges that come with the transition from traditional laparoscopic to robotic surgery. From better visibility to a more natural working position, spatial computing is opening up new possibilities for the entire surgical team. #XREAL #AURA #AndroidXR Android XR is a trademark of Google LLC. https://x.com/XREAL_Global/status/2125800881421697049/video/1

item.title: What changes in VR development when eyes and hands become the primary input? 👀
item.dc:creator: MetaVRDevs
item.content:encoded:
What changes in VR development when eyes and hands become the primary input? 👀
On Meta VR Glasses, people look to target and use their hands to act. Your app's interaction flow needs to account for gaze as well as presses and pinches.
Immersive Web SDK (IWSDK) 1.1 helps you prepare for the glasses with rebuilt hand emulation and eight rooms for passthrough emulation. Your coding agent uses IWSDK to drive the emulated hand, while your app detects the rooms' walls and furniture as it would a room scan.
Refine hand interactions across different spaces as you develop an experience for eyes and hands, then validate it on a device.
👉 Point your agent at http://iwsdk.dev/skill.md and start building
#MetaVR #WebXR #MetaVRGlasses https://x.com/MetaVRDevs/status/2124919669169754306/video/1

item.title: Early on November 21 JST, while responding to a serious policy violation, we also permanently banned a large number of a
item.dc:creator: VRChat
item.content:encoded:
Early on November 21 JST, while responding to a serious policy violation, we also permanently banned a large number of accounts that should not have been included in the action. Those bans have now been lifted.
We recognize that our decision abruptly interrupted relationships, creative activities, and planned gatherings that people had built within VRChat. We sincerely apologize to everyone affected, including their friends and communities, for the distress and disruption we caused.
The notices also failed to adequately explain the reasons for the bans, in some cases displaying only “Other.” We acknowledge that we did not provide enough information for affected users to understand the situation and make a meaningful appeal.
These decisions and reviews were carried out by our team, not AI. We do not believe that restoring access alone repairs the damage to trust. We will review the decisions and handling of this incident with the relevant teams and work to improve how we explain moderation actions and handle appeals.

item.title: More November updates 🎁
item.dc:creator: MetaVRDevs
item.content:encoded:
More November updates 🎁
This week's highlights help Unity apps account for Meta Quest 3's angled displays and make panels move like the system UI. If you're building WebXR experiences, Meta Quest Browser now supports WebGPU too.
Explore the thread below. 🧵 See all of the latest release notes 👉 https://developers.meta.com/vr/release-notes/?utm_source=social-x&utm_medium=MVRD&utm_campaign=organic&utm_content=releasenotes1120
#MetaVR #VRDev #XR #MetaVRGlasses
2/ Core SDK 🛠️
Core SDK v209's new Use Forward Head Pose setting helps distribute rendered pixels more evenly across Quest 3's angled displays. It's on by default and works with OpenXR.
If you're building for Meta VR Glasses, the FOV Simulator now includes a design-area guideline in OVRManager and Immersive Debugger to help you check where essential content sits within the field of view.
Explore the Core SDK update 👉 https://developers.meta.com/vr/downloads/package/meta-xr-core-sdk/?utm_source=social-x&utm_medium=MVRD&utm_campaign=organic&utm_content=releasenotes1120
3/ Interaction SDK 🖐️
Interaction SDK's OSPanelTransformer makes your app panels move like the system UI does. As a panel follows the user's head, it keeps the same apparent size even when its distance changes.
Explore the Interaction SDK update 👉 https://developers.meta.com/vr/downloads/package/meta-xr-interaction-sdk-ovr-integration/?utm_source=social-x&utm_medium=MVRD&utm_campaign=organic&utm_content=releasenotes1120
4/ Meta Quest Browser 🌐
Meta Quest Browser v156 adds WebGPU as a rendering option for your WebXR experiences. It also introduces an experimental way to update WebView without a full OS update, although that feature isn't available to all users.
Explore the Browser update 👉 https://developers.meta.com/vr/downloads/package/browser/156.0/?utm_source=social-x&utm_medium=MVRD&utm_campaign=organic&utm_content=releasenotes1120

item.title: Get More Out of XREAL AURA with These Power User Tips 👓
item.dc:creator: XREAL_Global
item.content:encoded:
Get More Out of XREAL AURA with These Power User Tips 👓
🔌 Connecting DP-in devices
The cable you use matters. Some DP-in devices, including flagship handheld gaming devices, require high-bandwidth DisplayPort to deliver the best performance. For optimal compatibility, use a cable that supports DisplayPort 1.4, HBR, and USB 3.0. A standard USB-C cable may fit the port but not meet these requirements.
🎬 Stream your favorite entertainment
Can't find Netflix, Apple TV, or Disney+ in Google Play? You can still access them through Chrome. Simply open Chrome on AURA, visit the streaming service's website, sign in, and enjoy your favorite shows and movies on a massive virtual screen with AURA's XR controls. No additional apps needed.
Save these tips for your next AURA session!

item.title: Official Statement: Rokid Glasses 2 Mainland China Version and Global Version
item.dc:creator: RokidGlobal
item.content:encoded:
Official Statement: Rokid Glasses 2 Mainland China Version and Global Version
The Rokid Glasses 2 Global Version is expected to debut at CES 2027 in Las Vegas. Please note that it is not the same version as the Mainland China Version currently on sale.
Key Differences
AI services: The primary difference between the two versions is the AI service stack. Full details will be published soon. ⚠️ Please note: using the Mainland China Version with Global AI services via the Hi Rokid app will require an additional AI subscription.
Regional services: Account systems, map services, AI models, payment services and data compliance requirements vary by region. As a result, certain features and service experiences may differ when a device is used outside its intended region.
After-sales and compliance: The Mainland China Version does not include Global after-sales coverage, nor does it carry the compliance certifications required in markets outside Mainland China.
How to Identify Your Version
Before purchase: Please check the packaging carefully for the following markings. 1. Seal sticker: The Mainland China Version features a plain black Rokid sticker. The Global Version sticker includes a glasses icon and a globe pattern. 2. Model number: The model name on the back label is RV301 for the Mainland China Version and RV302 for the Global Version. 3. Side label: The Mainland China Version label is printed in Simplified Chinese only. The Global Version label is printed in Traditional Chinese and English.
After purchase and activation: You can confirm your version under Device type in the Hi Rokid app.
Purchase Recommendation
To ensure a stable and complete product experience, we recommend purchasing the version designed for your country or region through an authorized local channel. Devices used outside their intended region may not support certain region-specific features.
We appreciate your patience and trust. More details on the Rokid Glasses 2 Global Version will be shared at CES 2027.

Also out today: · PICO Unity SDK 6.2.0 — image tracking, Unity dynamic lighting in PICO Spatial · PICO Unreal SDK 6.2.1 — image tracking, plus the new PICOUnrealMCP plugin for AI agents https://developer.picoxr.com/en/document/pico-unity-release-notes/https://developer.picoxr.com/en/document/pico-unreal-release-notes/
